iron-longsword.name: Iron Longsword
iron-longsword.description: A reliable one-handed blade with enough weight to turn a committed strike.
iron-longsword.purpose: Equip in your main hand. Uses Strength for attacks and deals 1d8 slashing damage.

steel-shield.name: Steel Shield
steel-shield.description: A broad shield marked by old repairs.
steel-shield.purpose: Equip in your off hand for +2 Armor Class. Cannot be used with a two-handed weapon.

chain-shirt.name: Chain Shirt
chain-shirt.description: Interlocking rings worn beneath a fitted leather coat.
chain-shirt.purpose: Sets base Armor Class to 13 and adds up to +2 from Dexterity.

leather-armor.name: Leather Armor
leather-armor.description: Supple boiled leather that protects without impeding movement.
leather-armor.purpose: Sets base Armor Class to 11 and adds your full Dexterity modifier.

studded-leather.name: Studded Leather
studded-leather.description: Flexible leather reinforced with close-set metal studs.
studded-leather.purpose: Sets base Armor Class to 12 and adds your full Dexterity modifier.

shortsword.name: Shortsword
shortsword.description: A quick, narrow blade suited to close quarters.
shortsword.purpose: Equip in your main hand. Uses the better of Strength or Dexterity and deals 1d6 piercing damage.

shortbow.name: Shortbow
shortbow.description: A compact bow with a waxed string and a dozen serviceable arrows.
shortbow.purpose: Equip in your main hand. Uses Dexterity and deals 1d6 piercing damage at range.

oak-staff.name: Oak Quarterstaff
oak-staff.description: A straight-grained staff banded with iron near the grip.
oak-staff.purpose: Equip in your main hand. Uses Strength and deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

ash-wand.name: Ash Wand
ash-wand.description: A scorched wand that steadies the shaping of arcane force.
ash-wand.purpose: Equip as an arcane focus. Grants +1 to spell attack rolls.

war-mace.name: War Mace
war-mace.description: A flanged iron mace balanced for one-handed use.
war-mace.purpose: Equip in your main hand. Uses Strength and deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage.

lute-blade.name: Courtier's Rapier
lute-blade.description: A slender duelling blade carried beside a travel-worn lute.
lute-blade.purpose: Equip in your main hand. Uses the better of Strength or Dexterity and deals 1d8 piercing damage.

healing-potion.name: Potion of Healing
healing-potion.description: A thumb-sized red vial that warms when uncorked.
healing-potion.purpose: Use as an action in or out of combat to restore 2d4 + 2 hit points.

antitoxin.name: Antitoxin
antitoxin.description: A bitter herbal draught sealed in green glass.
antitoxin.purpose: Use to end the Poisoned condition or gain advantage against the next poison save.

holy-water.name: Holy Water
holy-water.description: Consecrated water in a stoppered silver flask.
holy-water.purpose: Throw in combat to deal 2d6 radiant damage to undead, or use at certain profaned sites.

smoke-bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke-bomb.description: A clay shell packed with soot, saltpetre, and bitterleaf.
smoke-bomb.purpose: Use in combat to gain the Hidden condition and impose disadvantage on attacks against you until your next turn.

healers-kit.name: Healer's Kit
healers-kit.description: Bandages, needles, splints, and clean bitter spirits.
healers-kit.purpose: Outside combat, expend a use to restore 1d6 + 2 hit points. In combat, stabilize an unconscious ally.

thieves-tools.name: Thieves' Tools
thieves-tools.description: Picks, files, a narrow mirror, and folding pliers in a leather roll.
thieves-tools.purpose: Unlocks tool-assisted choices involving locks and traps; usually improves the odds of success.

silk-rope.name: Silk Rope
silk-rope.description: Fifty feet of light, strong rope.
silk-rope.purpose: Unlocks safer traversal choices and can prevent damage from climbs, pits, and swift water.

disguise-kit.name: Disguise Kit
disguise-kit.description: Pigments, wax, false hair, and reversible costume pieces.
disguise-kit.purpose: Unlocks disguise-based social approaches and may grant advantage on Deception checks.

scholars-journal.name: Scholar's Journal
scholars-journal.description: A field journal indexed with historical and arcane references.
scholars-journal.purpose: Can assist History or Arcana checks when time permits.

silver-chime.name: Silver Pilgrim Chime
silver-chime.description: A small chime engraved with the first wardens' vow.
silver-chime.purpose: A story item. Its clear note can awaken or quiet the ward-bell's ancient magic.

cult-seal.name: Black-Wax Cult Seal
cult-seal.description: A seal pressed with a thorn coiled around a cracked bell.
cult-seal.purpose: Evidence of the conspiracy and a possible key to cult-controlled doors.

warden-ledger.name: Warden's Cipher Ledger
warden-ledger.description: A coded ledger linking payments from Briarwatch to the bell cult.
warden-ledger.purpose: Strong evidence. It can turn frightened guards or villagers against the conspirator.

bellfire-locket.name: Bellfire Locket
bellfire-locket.description: A warm brass locket holding a sliver of resonant crystal.
bellfire-locket.purpose: Equip for +1 on Wisdom saving throws and certain checks involving the ward-bell.

thornward-cloak.name: Thornward Cloak
thornward-cloak.description: A moss-green cloak whose clasp is shaped like a closed briar.
thornward-cloak.purpose: Equip for +1 Armor Class and advantage on the first Survival check made in the Briarwood after resting.
